title: Good and simple, still many functionalites.
body:
Great for tracking anything. I'm using it for bad habbits, but you can use it to see, when you last clean your windows or anything else. Possible to switch hours, days ect. (it has 4 columns for example, days, hours, minutes, seconds) and you can write a note at every reset.
I recommending it.

title: Awesome
body:
This app is GREAT. I tried a lot of habit tracking / quit helping apps, but this one is the best by far. Simple, intuitive UX, beaitiful minimalistic design, no ads, no subscriptions, no hidden payments. I 100% recommend this one. Great work guys!

The only thing I miss is a donate button, because I definitely want to support apps (and teams) like this!
